author: New China TV
description:
For more than 80 years, villagers in Huawu, a small village in Jiangxi Province, have honored 17 Red Army soldiers who planted pine trees before leaving for war - and never returned. 
Every Qingming Festival, the villagers come to pay their respects. 
Over generations, this tradition has become a living memory of sacrifice, a reminder that the peace and prosperity they enjoy today were hard-won by those who paved the way.
title: 17 pines: A Chinese village's remembrance across generations

description:

Having served for 11 years, the veteran dog responded to over 100 operations and helped crack drug trafficking cases.
title: Loyalty beyond words: Retired police dog's heartbreaking farewell with his trainer.

author: New China TV
description:
"Everything has been built so beautifully. I wish your father could have seen it too."
108-year-old Duan Guixiu is one of the last surviving widows of Red Army martyrs in Yudu County, China's Jiangxi Province.
For decades, she held onto a promise made by her husband shortly after their marriage -- that he would one day return to her.
Yet, though the return she longed for never came, she lived to see the world that the martyrs had fought so hard to create -- a life well-provided for, a life that carried the weight of their sacrifices.
title: A lifelong wait for a Chinese revolutionary soldier
